description: Original media for the editing modules (4-8): every file derives from the verified build-queue recording (public/media/build-queue.mp4), the original extracted frames (public/media/frames/) or the synthetic tone (public/media/build/tone.wav). All files are original to this course; no third-party media is used.
ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

cropped-zoom.mp4.note: Crops the centre half of the picture and scales it back to 960x540: the Module 4 readability example.

half-size-crf23.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf scale=640:360 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p edit/half-size-crf23.mp4
half-size-crf23.mp4.note: 640x360 at CRF 23 (FFmpeg's default quality): also the Module 4 plain scale-down contrast.

callout.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf drawtext=fontfile=DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf:text='Build queue - sorted by duration':fontcolor=white:fontsize=28:x=20:y=20:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6:boxborderw=8 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p edit/callout.mp4
callout.mp4.note: A persistent callout drawn with DejaVu Sans (SIL OFL 1.1, bundled with the sandbox FFmpeg build).

timed-callout.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf drawtext=fontfile=DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf:text='Build queue - sorted by duration':fontcolor=white:fontsize=28:x=20:y=20:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6:boxborderw=8:enable='between(t,3,5)' -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p edit/timed-callout.mp4
timed-callout.mp4.note: A callout that appears only between 3 and 5 seconds.

crossfade.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -t 6 -i frames/000.jpg -loop 1 -t 6 -i frames/072.jpg -filter_complex xfade=transition=fade:duration=1:offset=5 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 edit/crossfade.mp4
crossfade.mp4.note: A one-second fade between two original extracted frames.

zoom-pan.mp4.note: The Sort-action frame held for six seconds.

captioned.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf subtitles=captions.srt -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p edit/captioned.mp4
captioned.mp4.note: The three-line caption track burned into the picture at full size.

captioned-small.mp4.note: The same captions at 640x360: caption text that was readable at 960x540 becomes hard to read when the picture is scaled down.

half-size-crf18.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf scale=640:360 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 18 edit/half-size-crf18.mp4

half-size-crf35.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf scale=640:360 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 35 edit/half-size-crf35.mp4

quarter-size-crf23.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -vf scale=480:270 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 23 edit/quarter-size-crf23.mp4
quarter-size-crf23.mp4.note: 480x270 at CRF 23: same quality setting, smaller picture.

quiet-tone.wav.note: The synthetic tone at 5% volume: almost inaudible.

over-tone.wav.note: The synthetic tone at 200% volume: clipped and distorted.

band-tone.wav.note: The synthetic tone band-limited like a telephone line.

mixed-tone.wav.command: ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100:duration=6 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=660:sample_rate=44100:duration=6 -filter_complex amix=inputs=2:duration=first -c:a pcm_s16le edit/mixed-tone.wav
mixed-tone.wav.note: Two synthetic tones mixed: two sounds at once.

quiet-audio.mp4.command: ffmpeg -y -i public/media/build-queue.mp4 -i edit/quiet-tone.wav -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v copy -c:a aac -shortest edit/quiet-audio.mp4
quiet-audio.mp4.note: The recording with the 5% tone as its sound: picture unchanged, sound nearly silent.

captions.srt.command: authored directly; burned into captioned.mp4 and captioned-small.mp4 with the subtitles filter
captions.srt.note: The caption source used for captioned.mp4 and captioned-small.mp4. Three cues covering the whole 10-second recording.
